steps.action: The package packages/spawner must pass `mypy --strict` (per repo's strict mypy.ini profile) without weakening or modifying any tests. Investigate and fix ALL strict-mode type errors across every file in packages/spawner/src/aurora_spawner/ (spawner.py, circuit_breaker.py, early_detection.py, heartbeat.py, models.py, observability.py, recovery.py, timeout_policy.py, __init__.py). You will be given the mypy check output describing exact errors (file, line, message) after each attempt: use it to locate and fix problems iteratively. Common fixes needed: add explicit return-type annotations to nested/inner functions lacking them (e.g. functions like read_stdout/read_stderr inside spawn()); add narrowing guards (e.g. `assert x is not None` or `if x is not None:`) before attribute access on Optional-typed values such as process.stdout/process.stderr from asyncio subprocess, mirroring existing guard patterns already used for process.stdin; ensure all function parameters and return types are annotated; fix any Any-typed return that strict mode flags; do not add unused `# type: ignore` comments (warn_unused_ignores is enabled) and do not add type: ignore where a real annotation/guard fix is possible. Do NOT modify anything under packages/spawner/tests/ — tests are already exempted by mypy.ini and must not be weakened or altered. Do not remove or change runtime behavior (e.g. do not delete the currently-unused buffer accumulation in read_stderr; just annotate/guard it if needed) — only add/adjust type annotations, narrowing guards, and minimal structural fixes required to satisfy strict typing. Use recall/get to inspect symbols across all listed files (not just spawner.py) rather than reading whole files. Keep iterating using the mypy check output until it reports zero errors for packages/spawner.
